test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between B and L. C sits to the immediate left of L. No one sits to the right of Y. Only two people sit between Y and C. Z sits to the immediate right of A.

How many people sit between X and Z?
solution:
Given, Seven people, A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. 

No one sits to the right of Y.

Only two people sit between Y and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2a75bb46663815ec2b07cbbf7c056410c7fd5da4bbba1b0a327ddf9eaf482a4.png] 

Only three people sit between B and L. 

C sits to the immediate left of L. 

Z sits to the immediate right of A.

X sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e72b43df23176399298575e7ab6e4ecffdab956321203710324118a0bfe0ce5.png] 

So 2 people sit between X and Z.

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 4"**
